About Us

Reliable Cleaning Service

Since opening our doors, we’ve been committed to providing service of the highest quality, paying particular attention to working efficiently while keeping the lines of communication with our clients clear and concise.Our mission at Sergent's Cleaning Services is simple: to provide high-quality services in a timely manner. Our team caters to each project’s specific needs to ensure excellence. We hope you’ll find what you’re looking for. For more information or general inquiries, feel free to get in touch today.

Opening Hours

Come Visit

Mon - Fri: 9am - 6pm
Sat: 10am - 2pm
Sun: Closed

Residential Cleaning Services

Call to schedule a free estimate

*Daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and one-time cleaning.*Deep Cleaning, seasonal*Hard surfaces clean by hand including windows*Carpet cleaning,deodorizing, and extractions*Move-in and Move-outs*Home Sales preparations*Property clean outs*Renovations and post construction* Before and after cleaningHoliday cleaning

Commercial Cleaning Service

Expert Service

Sergent's Cleaning Services is committed to getting the job done, especially when it comes to this service. You can count on us to be professional, timely, efficient and make sure you’re satisfied every step of the way. We handle small cleaning such as offices, banks, apartment complexes, etc. Why put the stress of cleaning on your employees, when you can have a professional take care of it for you? Call/text today to schedule an on-site free estimate.
Some common tasks:*Emptying trash*Vacuuming, mopping floors*Dusting*Cleaning breakrooms*Cleaning bathrooms*Etc.

Moving In/Out Cleaning Service

Attention to Detail

Whether you are moving in or moving out we can handle what's behind! We offer detailed cleans to get your old place shinning like new to maybe help you get your deposit back if your renting or your new place sparkling and ready to move-in.

Laundry Services

COMMING SOON!!

Yes we will be doing laundry services. Including an available pick-up and drop-off services. This is an ultimate time saver for your busy schedule. Sergent's Cleaning Services is committed to getting the job done, especially when it comes to this service. You can count on us to be professional, timely, efficient and make sure you’re satisfied every step of the way.

Disinfectant Service

It's all about feeling safe in your space!

Whether it's covid-19 or just the common flu Sergent's Cleaning Services can make you feel safe inside your home or office.

Extra Cleaning Service

Carpet Cleaning

We have the experience and skills necessary to tackle just about every type of job that comes our way. With Sergent's Cleaning Services, clients know exactly what to expect - professionalism, efficiency and exceptional results.
